annotation_method: Manual interval review of the user-selected clips and their on-screen red-X/green-check coaching overlays.

labels.good: Comparable real-person strict curl footage with an explicit correct-form indication or a clean user-selected demonstration.
labels.bad: Comparable real-person footage explicitly presented as an error.
labels.exclude: Transition, explanation-only shot, animation, two-person comparison, or a different curl variant/equipment.

reference_only.reason: Two people and an edited camera jump make the single-pose sequence inconsistent; the first trial showed that it reduced grouped-video AUC to near chance.
Correct and incorrect people share one frame; a single-pose detector cannot assign the frame label safely.
